svg.title: Separator · circle (wildlife crests)
svg.desc: Radius 12.65 (wildlife-caps). wildlife-long uses radius 9. Placed at y=446 / y=215 on the crest in the engine. Isolated from bc-ministry-primitives-v5/src/engine.js → drawBadge. Original coordinates retained; only the viewBox is cropped. Reference-based reconstruction, not an official master.
